summary_bullets: Add lint-awk-multibyte-regex to catch non-ASCII bytes in dynamic awk regex contexts at commit time
Classify ship-pr vendor exit-0 with no commits as first-fixer-non-health for autonomous CI-fix fallback
Wire the lint through Makefile, pre-commit, docs/linting.md, and agent-lint.toml; extend fix-loop harness coverage
commit_message:
Add awk multibyte-regex lint and ship-pr no-commit vendor bail

Introduce scripts/lint-awk-multibyte-regex.sh to flag non-ASCII bytes in awk -v values and awk-body regex callsites, with Makefile, pre-commit, and harness wiring. Teach run_ci_fix_vendor to treat a successful stage-and-push with unchanged HEAD as first-fixer-non-health so exit-0 vendors that make no commit route to the autonomous main-agent CI-fix path. Fixes #3134.
